condition.title: Condition
condition.rawStatsTip: Shown as raw numbers, not a bar like the vitals above: PanelBridge sends these values, but which of them use a 0-1 scale versus 0-100 hasn't been confirmed against the game itself for every one of them. A colored bar would have to guess the scale, and a confidently wrong severity is worse than no severity at all.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.intro: Loaded on request: reading a large inventory takes the server a moment.
inventory.noneSaved: No inventory saved for this character yet. It's saved when someone loads it while the player is online.
inventory.truncated: Only the first {{maxItems}} items were read; the rest aren't listed.
inventory.timeBudget: PanelBridge stopped reading after {{ms}} ms so the server stays smooth; some items aren't listed.
inventory.truncatedDepth: Contents nested deeper than {{depth}} containers aren't listed.

hints.title: Worth a look
hints.subtitle: Numbers that stand out for this character. They're prompts to check, not conclusions.
hints.badgeAria: Worth a look: open the Character tab
hints.canSpawnItems: This account's role can spawn items.

powersOnRegularAccount.title: Powers on a regular account
powersOnRegularAccount.detail: Admin powers are on for an account whose role has none.
powersOnRegularAccount.rule: Flags any admin power (god mode, invisible, no clip and the others) on a player whose role doesn't include admin powers.
powersOnRegularAccount.innocent: An admin turned a power on for this player and didn't turn it off, or the player's role changed since.

debugItems.title: Debug items
debugItems.detail: Carrying items the game only has for developers and testing.
debugItems.rule: Flags the game's debug and test items, such as the test mugs and the debug yardstick. They don't appear in normal play.
debugItems.innocent: Given by an admin or a mod, or picked up from someone who had them.

skillJump.title: Fast skill gain
skillJump.detail: {{total}} levels gained in the last {{minutes}} minutes.
skillJump.rule: Flags one skill gaining {{onePerk}} or more levels to reach level {{minLevel}}, a passive skill (Fitness, Strength) gaining {{passive}} or more, or {{totalLevels}} or more levels above level {{floor}} in total, within {{window}} minutes. With an XP multiplier or a skill book, the gain is first divided by it: one skill stands out only if its XP, divided that way, is still {{rawXp}} or more. Compared with the snapshot from {{sinceTime}}.
skillJump.innocent: Several skill books read in a row, a long burst of crafting or fighting, a high XP multiplier, or XP an admin gave in-game.

skillsAheadOfTime.title: Skills ahead of play time
skillsAheadOfTime.detail: {{advanced}} skill levels above level {{floor}} after about {{hours}} h of play this life, where about {{allowed}} is usual.
skillsAheadOfTime.rule: Counts every level above {{floor}} in non-passive skills, with skill-book levels at half weight. Usual is {{perHour}} levels per real hour of this life, times the server's XP multiplier ({{xpScale}}), plus {{grace}}. Stands out past twice that.
skillsAheadOfTime.innocent: Long sessions spent on one skill, skill books and magazines, a high XP multiplier, or play time the estimate can't see.

manyMaxedSkills.title: Several skills at level 10
manyMaxedSkills.rule: Flags {{minCount}} or more skills at level 10 within {{hours}} hours of play (scaled by the XP multiplier), or {{share}}% of all skills at 10 at any time. Skills the character started at 10 don't count. Stands out from {{strong}}.
manyMaxedSkills.innocent: A very long life, or a character carried over from another save or server.

overCapacity.title: Carrying far over the limit
overCapacity.rule: Flags carrying more than {{factor}} times the character's weight limit.
overCapacity.innocent: Hauling heavy loot or a generator, a moment right after picking something up, a change in strength, or the unlimited carry power switched on by an admin.

unusualQuantity.title: Large amount of one item
unusualQuantity.detail: Carrying {{threshold}} or more of one item.
unusualQuantity.rule: Flags {{threshold}} or more units of one item type, counted across every bag.
unusualQuantity.innocent: Ammunition, nails or other small items gathered over a long life.

hiddenItems.title: Hidden items
hiddenItems.detail: Carrying items the game hides from its item lists.
hiddenItems.rule: Flags items marked Hidden in the game's scripts, unless they're being worn. Normal play rarely hands them out.
hiddenItems.innocent: Some mods and events give them out, and a few come from containers or recipes.

obsoleteItems.title: Obsolete items
obsoleteItems.detail: Carrying items the game marks as obsolete.
obsoleteItems.rule: Flags items marked Obsolete in the game's scripts. They no longer spawn.
obsoleteItems.innocent: Carried over from an older version of the game or of this save.

actionTiles.removeFromWhitelistDesc: They can no longer join a whitelist-only server
